title: Hindi H1 Sample Pack
goal: Take a zero-knowledge learner through a no-shame Hindi restart using listen-first teaching before moving to consonants.

lessons.title: Hindi Is For Me
lessons.learningOutcome: Learner feels safe restarting Hindi and hears the difference between अ and आ.
quizOutline: Which sound is short: अ or आ?
Which sound is used in आम?
Which letter should the learner trace after hearing the longer sound?
What picture anchor is used for आ?
What should happen first in this lesson: listening or testing?
lessons.heroPrompt: A warm, child-friendly Indian learning corner with a smiling learner, gentle teacher presence, one ripe mango on the desk, soft classroom light, calm educational illustration style, no text or letters.

videoScenes.narration: Hindi is for you. We will go slowly. We will listen first.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Smiling child seated calmly at a study table, friendly Hindi teacher figure nearby, warm yellow and orange palette.

videoScenes.narration: अ... अ... अ... repeat seven times.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Single bright orange teaching shape on a clean cream background with gentle motion lines, short-sound mood, no letters or text.

videoScenes.narration: आ... आ... आ... repeat seven times. आ for आम.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Ripe mango beside a longer flowing orange sound ribbon on a simple bright background, no letters or text.

videoScenes.narration: Short sound: अ. Long sound: आ.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Two side-by-side sound waves, one short and one long, in a clean comparison layout, no letters or text.

videoScenes.narration: Now trace one big अ and one big आ.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Blank handwriting practice sheet with two bold tracing paths and a child's pencil entering frame, no letters or text.

lessons.title: Swar Set 1
lessons.learningOutcome: Learner recognizes and repeats अ, आ, इ, ई using image anchors.
quizOutline: Which letter matches mango?
Which letter matches tamarind?
Which sound is longer: इ or ई?
Which letter should be shown after hearing sugarcane?
What should the learner do before tracing?
lessons.heroPrompt: A colorful early-Hindi learning scene with mango, tamarind, sugarcane, and a calm study-table layout, child-safe educational art, no text or letters.

videoScenes.narration: Today we learn four swar: अ, आ, इ, ई.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Four colorful sound tokens in a row on a cream background, no letters or text.

videoScenes.narration: आ for आम. इ for इमली. ई for ईख.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Three clean anchor objects: mango, tamarind, sugarcane, arranged on a study table, no letters or text.

videoScenes.narration: Each sound repeats seven times with pauses.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Playful rhythm dots and sound-wave shapes around simple teaching tiles, no letters or text.

videoScenes.narration: Trace after listening.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Blank dotted tracing paths on worksheets with a pencil and child hand, no letters or text.

videoScenes.narration: Show me आ. Show me इ. Show me ई.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Teacher hand pointing to mixed colorful study objects on a table, no letters or text.

lessons.title: Swar Set 2
lessons.learningOutcome: Learner recognizes उ, ऊ, ए, ऐ and starts simple sound discrimination.
quizOutline: Which letter matches glasses?
Which word is the anchor for ऊ?
Which sound is shorter: उ or ऊ?
Which card should be picked after hearing ए?
What happens after this lesson?
lessons.heroPrompt: A bright child-safe learning scene with owl, wool, heel, and glasses as anchor objects, uncluttered school illustration style, no text or letters.

videoScenes.narration: Now we add उ, ऊ, ए, ऐ.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Four fresh glowing sound tokens appearing one by one, no letters or text.

videoScenes.narration: उ is shorter. ऊ is longer.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Two rounded sound shapes side by side with short and long wave patterns, no letters or text.

videoScenes.narration: ए and ऐ sound different. Listen carefully.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Two front-sound shapes with simple mouth icons in a clean comparison layout, no letters or text.

videoScenes.narration: उल्लू, ऊन, एड़ी, ऐनक.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Owl, wool, heel, and glasses arranged in a clean 2x2 teaching grid, no letters or text.

videoScenes.narration: Now mix all eight swar and listen carefully.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Eight colorful sound tokens scattered on a playful cream background, no letters or text.

lessons.title: First Sound Confidence Check
lessons.learningOutcome: Learner completes a calm mixed-sound check and knows whether to repeat H1 or move to H2.
quizOutline: Play a sound and choose the matching letter.
Play आम and choose the matching swar.
Which two sounds need the learner's extra revision?
Should the learner be pushed forward if still confused?
What is the next pack after H1?
lessons.heroPrompt: A cheerful mixed-sound revision scene with colorful learning objects and a calm parent-guided check atmosphere, bright but uncluttered, no text or letters.

videoScenes.narration: This is not an exam. It is a confidence check.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Smiling child and parent seated together with flashcards on a table.

videoScenes.narration: Hear the sound. Point to the right card.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Eight mixed study tokens in a semicircle on the table, no letters or text.

videoScenes.narration: Hear the word. Choose the matching swar.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Anchor objects for mango, tamarind, wool, glasses and more arranged clearly on a table, no letters or text.

videoScenes.narration: Repeat only the weak sounds. Celebrate the strong ones.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Known items grouped confidently and missed items gently spotlighted, no symbols, letters, or text.

videoScenes.narration: If the learner is ready, next comes H2 consonants.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Preview of the next pack using four colorful blank learning tiles on a soft golden background, no letters or text.
